items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And he sent in one of Lennie Tristano’s guys, Harold Barnowski, but I just wanted Roy.

ctx.x: Oh. I guess he’s pretty good.

So he called me up a half hour before the date. And he sent in one of Lennie Tristano’s guys, Harold Barnowski, but I just wanted Roy. That might have made the whole difference with the thing. And anyhow, that’s the story with that thing. So I had one big band, then a quartet album with Bob Dorough and some other people and I got about four or five albums on Bethlehem, some arranged things at the time.
Meanwhile, while you’re doing this recording, what kind of — are you living in New York City?
